name: Alpine bedrock v1
prompt: Seamless square diffuse/albedo texture for real-time alpine mountain bedrock with triplanar mapping. Orthographic photographic scan of a continuous weathered grey granite and slate cliff face: broad irregular angular slabs, long fine fissures, eroded mineral streaks and sparse ochre iron staining. Cool neutral mid-grey, subtle warm variation, fine granular surface, uniform overcast light. Fill edge to edge, tileable on all four edges. No baked directional shadows, vignette, horizon, loose cobbles, paving, masonry, snow, grass, trees, sky, text or border. Read as the raw face of a vast old mountain.
